annotations.title: List the pages AI crawlers read most

description: Which pages of the brand's site AI crawlers fetched most, every bot on a page added up, verified hits only. liveRetrievalHits are fetches for answers being written now (a ChatGPT-User fetch means someone's question pulled that page); trainingHits are crawls for model training, which tend to sweep every page evenly, so they say little about which pages matter. Ordered by live retrieval, then training; purpose "training" orders by training instead. bots says which bots fetched each page. Pass contentOnly to drop files, framework data and sign-in pages. A page fetched is not a page cited: shruwd_list_sources says what the answers cite. For one bot, or where errors came from, use shruwd_list_crawler_paths. Kept 90 days.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

contentOnly.description: Only pages a person reads (contentPage true).

purpose.description: Only pages this kind of crawler fetched, ordered by its hits.

name: shruwd_list_crawler_pages
title: List the pages AI crawlers read most
